observed.briefing_modal: How to Build Your Global StrategyEach round, you make decisions across three strategic layers:1TECHNOLOGYDesign platforms, invest in R&D, choose which capabilities to build. Your technology is what you sell. Gen 1 gets you started. Gen 2 and Gen 3 unlock new markets and customer segments — but require sustained investment and prerequisite capability.2MARKET EXECUTIONPrice, promote, distribute, and produce for each product in each market. Match your offering to what local customers actually value — not what works at home.3STRATEGIC ARCHITECTURETalent and organizational structure. Market entry modes and localization investment.
